source_snapshot.procedure: Use hardcoded socket1/port2 registers, inject generic UCE, observe CTE/DPCTS/link down, release and expect automatic clear/retrain to Gen4.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal system with conditional PCIe management events and indicator.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; keyword logs miss the defining register state machine.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires per-port register translation, CTO semantics, ownership and retraining proof.

old_problem: One example socket/port/register hierarchy and Gen4 speed were presented as Socket 1~N, while generic `uce` was not proven to select completion timeout or the active AER/DPC ownership policy.
disposition_reason: The source already defines the essential state machine—clean pre-state, CTE/DPCTS containment and link down, then automatic clear and retrain after one release. ED-03 permits per-platform register paths, original speed/width and package CTO selector as signed runtime bindings; ED-16 blocks injection until supplied. Comparing each port to its own baseline resolves the example-value conflict without reducing Socket 1~N coverage.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 34, same-row AI fields, record 2437 and next pending row 35.
Preserved the register-level eDPC/CTO transition independently of generic UCE cases.
Rejected socket1/port2 and Gen4 as universal values.
Retained the prohibition on manual clearing because automatic clear is test evidence.
No halt, injector, release or register write was executed.

test_case.test_name: eDPC completion-timeout containment and automatic recovery
test_case.purpose: Across every approved socket/downstream port, prove an injected completion timeout triggers the expected eDPC register/link transition and automatic recovery to the captured baseline.
required_package: Supported package hash and explicit CTO selector mapping
EMCA/AER/DPC ownership plus CT mask/severity definitions
Per-port baseline speed/width and exact CTE/DPCTS/DLLA oracle
Endpoint quiesce, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration
test_case.test_command: For one freshly mapped, quiesced port, capture clean CTE/DPCTS state, CT severity/mask, DPC enable and original link. The FAE executes the signed CTO stimulus while halted, captures containment and DLLA/link-down state, issues exactly one approved release, and records automatic status clear plus retrain to that port's original speed/width before health/restoration checks.
test_case.expected_result: Each mapped port asserts the specified CTE/DPCTS containment state and loses link as designed, then clears automatically and restores the same endpoint at its captured speed/width without host or device residual failure.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed CTO selector and complete pre/during/post register-link timeline for all targets, automatic—not manual—clear, baseline retrain and endpoint health. Generic PCIe logs, example paths/speeds, wrong bits or failed retrain cannot pass.
safety_gate: Independent console and quiesced endpoint with current path map.
Prove CTO non-fatal policy and DPC enable before one stimulus.
Abort on wrong path/bit, fatal escalation, host reset or unrecovered link.
Do not clear evidence registers or auto-retry.
expected_evidence: Package hash, CTO mapping and ownership policy
Windows PCIe event plus endpoint/host health and applicable platform evidence
test_case.recovery: If automatic clear/retrain fails, leave registers untouched, preserve OOB evidence and use the approved platform recovery; restore BIOS/ownership settings and verify the endpoint before any separate rerun approval.

source_conflict.reason: Example paths/speeds are converted to per-target runtime baselines and generic UCE must be vendor-proven as CTO before use.

blocked.reason: The state transition and recovery oracle are complete; platform path and selector values safely gate execution.
